meta.name: polish
meta.description: Final quality pass before shipping. Fixes alignment, spacing, consistency, and detail issues that separate good from great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 修复设计细节，提升作品精致度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做设计但总在最后发现对齐或间距问题
copy.tagline_en: Fix design details to polish your work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often catch alignment or spacing issues at the last minute

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对你的设计或代码做最终质量检查，修复对齐、间距、一致性等细节问题，确保作品达到可发布标准。
howto.when: 当你完成功能开发，准备发布前，可以要求 Claude 进行抛光。

say.text: 帮我抛光这个页面，检查对齐和间距。
say.note: Claude 会检查视觉对齐和间距一致性。

say.text: 检查一下这个组件的所有交互状态。
say.note: Claude 会检查默认、悬停、聚焦等状态是否完整。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs a final quality pass on your design or code, fixing alignment, spacing, consistency, and detail issues to ensure it's ready for shipping.
howto.when_en: When you have completed functional development and are about to ship, you can ask Claude to polish.

say_en.text: Polish this page, check alignment and spacing.
say_en.note: Claude will check visual alignment and spacing consistency.

say_en.text: Check all interaction states of this component.
say_en.note: Claude will verify default, hover, focus, and other states.
